name: agkit_apply

plan_id.description: The id of an open plan (as returned by a `_plan` tool or listed by agkit_plan_read).

name: agkit_provider_key_plan
description:
add: Plan storing a provider credential. Prefer a NAMED secret: pass api_key as {source:"env",name} or {source:"file",path} (both must be pre-declared by the operator with `agkit secret-source add`) so the caller never carries the material; {source:"inline",value} is the last resort and DOES carry it. NOTE: source "inline" places the secret value in conversation context — prefer "env" or "file", which name a pre-declared source instead of carrying the material. Returns a plan; apply it with agkit_apply.
rotate: Plan rotating a provider credential to a NEW key (prod-rebinding). Prefer a NAMED secret: pass api_key as {source:"env",name} or {source:"file",path} (both must be pre-declared by the operator with `agkit secret-source add`) so the caller never carries the new material; {source:"inline",value} is the last resort and DOES carry it. NOTE: source "inline" places the secret value in conversation context — prefer "env" or "file", which name a pre-declared source instead of carrying the material. Returns a plan; apply it with agkit_apply.

api_key.description: How to obtain the secret: {source:"env",name} reads a pre-declared environment variable, {source:"file",path} reads a pre-declared file, {source:"inline",value} carries the value. source "inline" places the secret value in conversation context — prefer "env" or "file", which name a pre-declared source instead of carrying the material.

name.description: Name of an environment variable holding the secret (the NAME, never the value).

path.description: Absolute path to a file whose CONTENT is the secret (regular file, mode 600, POSIX only).

value.description: The secret value itself. source "inline" places the secret value in conversation context — prefer "env" or "file", which name a pre-declared source instead of carrying the material.

auth-style.description: Custom BYO endpoint: the auth style (server-owned closed vocabulary).

endpoint-url.description: Custom BYO endpoint: the full endpoint URL (the server owns https-only and egress policy).

extra-header.description: A non-secret metadata header, name=value (repeatable). The server enforces a CLOSED allowlist of non-secret header names and teaches on violation; a secret NEVER belongs here (the key rides the auth header only).

header-name.description: Custom BYO endpoint: the auth header name (e.g. api-key).

provider.description: The provider slug to store a credential for (server-owned vocabulary).

name: agkit_quota_plan
description:
clear (kind=agent): Clear named quota caps to uncapped (null); other members keep their current values.
clear (kind=media): Clear named media caps to unlimited (other caps carried forward unchanged).
set (kind=agent): Set usage-quota caps (named members only; the others keep their current values).
set (kind=media): Set ALL six media caps (each an explicit value or `unlimited`; prod-rebinding).

fields.description: Comma-separated quota members to clear to uncapped (the nullable five; see --help).

max-audio-seconds-per-day.description: Clear the daily audio-seconds cap to unlimited.

max-dubbing-jobs-per-day.description: Clear the daily dubbing-jobs cap to unlimited.

max-image-generations-per-day.description: Clear the daily image-generation cap to unlimited.

max-video-generations-per-day.description: Clear the daily video-generation cap to unlimited.

media-budget-alert-threshold-usd.description: Clear the alert threshold to unset.

monthly-media-budget-usd.description: Clear the monthly media budget to unlimited.

max-monthly-spend-per-user-usd.description: Per-user monthly spend cap (2-dp USD string).

max-requests-per-second-per-user.description: Per-user request-rate cap (1..1000; the one member with no uncapped null).

monthly-spend-alert-threshold-usd.description: Alert threshold (2-dp USD string; server enforces threshold <= cap).

monthly-spend-cap-usd.description: Project monthly spend cap (2-dp USD string, e.g. "100.00").

media-budget-alert-threshold-usd.description: Alert threshold (2-dp USD string or `unlimited`; server enforces threshold <= budget).

monthly-media-budget-usd.description: Monthly media budget (2-dp USD string or `unlimited`).

name: agkit_quota_read
description:
get (kind=agent): Show the project's usage quotas (caps + current usage).
get (kind=media): Show the project's media quotas (absent = not configured).

name: agkit_revenuecat_plan
description: Delete the RevenueCat binding — hard-deletes the row (the dashboard's 'disable' label is a mislabel); end-user entitlement gating stops (destructive, prod-rebinding).

name: agkit_revenuecat_read
description: Show the project's RevenueCat binding config (the secret API key is never returned).

name: agkit_route_plan
description:
create: Create a model route (prod-rebinding): bind a tier to a model/provider/execution-target.
delete: Delete a model route (prod-rebinding, destructive).
update: Update a model route (prod-rebinding): patch its binding members (tier is immutable).

attestation.description: Attestation policy for this route (server-owned vocabulary).

default.description: Whether this route is the tier's default (default false).

enabled.description: Whether the route is live (default true).

execution-target.description: Where inference executes (server-owned bindable registry, fail-closed).

fallback-execution-target.description: Fallback execution target; ABSENT sends an explicit null (no fallback).

model.description: The model this tier binds to (server-owned vocabulary).

provider.description: The provider serving the model (server-owned vocabulary).

tier.description: The client-visible tier this route binds (server-owned vocabulary).

clear-fallback-execution-target.description: Clear the fallback execution target (sends an explicit null).

default.description: Make (or unmake) this route the tier's default: --default true|false.

fallback-execution-target.description: New fallback execution target (use --clear-fallback-execution-target to unset).

get: Show one model route by id.
list: List model routes for the current project (tier → model/provider/execution-target bindings).
